hardware.signal_path: Guitar output to splitter, separately to audio interface for direct input and to amplifier. This selection uses the directinput archive member.

archive.verification: Selective official HTTP ZIP ranges were retained with SHA-256 receipts. Each selected decompressed original member was independently rechecked for byte length and CRC32 against the retained central directory and SHA-256 against the original acquisition receipt. The published whole-archive MD5 identifies the release; it is not represented as independently recomputed. No whole-archive SHA-256 is claimed.

media.decoder: Independent SMF chunk/VLQ/running-status/tempo parser; all track names and note event fields agree with separately retained original-byte parse.

selection_protocol.onset_oracle: First crossing of 25% of the first second peak of centered 2 ms RMS, existing BuildDryReferenceComparisons.py onset_frame; one source12 first-note measurement only.
selection_protocol.event_timing: All selected original MIDI note starts, ends, note pitches and velocities retained after the one common group offset. No per-note or transfer-check onset fit. A and B receive identical production score events; B retains A model crop.
selection_protocol.gain_and_processing: Native 48 kHz source channel 0, fixed integer crops, one constant whole-file RMS gain per track to −24 dBFS followed by shared .94 sample-peak headroom. No EQ, denoise, time stretch, pitch shift, per-note gain, peak search, reference splice or runtime sample incorporation.

Source06 rows and their earlier alignment group are unchanged. Source12 is another excerpt from the same performer and guitar, not an independent hardware holdout or a repetition of the G3 phrase.

No EQ, denoising, time warp, pitch shift, dynamic gain or synthetic reference splice. Fixed crop and one whole-file listening gain only.
Crop ends while the last selected note is still annotated held, before its following different-string attack and precursor. No fabricated final source NoteOff or decay tail.
Model GuitarBuild 0.8 and existing bridge settings remain shared A/B; heavier eight-string geometry and pickup configuration do not fit this lighter six-string bridge-neck source.

exclusions: P3_06 descending phrases are multi-string chord gestures, not isolated-string reference phrases.
P3_02 ending E-string descent has held G55 and D50 annotations; excluded despite apparent foreground E melody.
P3_03 treble descents at11.6-12.3s and16.4-17.1s sit over held lower-string annotations; excluded.
No claim that mono DI can prove absence of all sympathetic string motion; selected source12 phrases have single-string annotations and compatible waveform/harmonic context.
limits: Both source12 passages come from the same P3 performer, guitar, capture chain and original music excerpt; the high-E row is a string/register transfer check, not an actual repeat or independent hardware holdout.
Six-string source hardware does not establish the behavior of Electry lowest eight-string E1 or its thicker string set.

Per-string tracker annotations and compatible waveform/harmonic context support a single intentionally played string in each crop. Mono DI cannot prove absence of all sympathetic vibration, handling motion or residual body modes.
Tracker MIDI velocities are not measured pick forces; annotation note gaps do not uniquely label pick, hammer or pull-off gestures. Sustain is a declared model audition approximation.
The high-E phrase later notes have original MIDI velocities 40 and 33 versus first 127. They are kept quiet; separate per-note normalization would erase source dynamics.
The prototype and main model share existing GuitarBuild 0.8 bridge voicing, not a fit to the lighter source bridge-neck pickup configuration.
Source12 transfer-onset residual of approximately 4.45 ms is retained and limits per-note timing interpretations. No candidate-specific source alignment is fitted.
